# Subway Seat for rofi

Colors on rofi's default layout: the window on the raised paper ground, a text-wash selection, gold matches, denim for active entries and orange for urgent ones. The palette's roles are defined as variables (`@text-hi`, `@orange`) for anything you add after `@theme`.

[rofi](https://github.com/davatorium/rofi) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/rofi/) · Needs rofi 1.7+

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/rofi/config.rasi, at the end (or pick it in `rofi-theme-selector`):

```css
@theme "subway-seat"
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/rofi/config.rasi, at the end (or pick it in `rofi-theme-selector`):

```css
@theme "subway-seat-tunnel"
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.config/rofi/config.rasi, at the end (or pick it in `rofi-theme-selector`):

```css
@theme "subway-seat-enamel"
```

**London Moquette**, in ~/.config/rofi/config.rasi, at the end (or pick it in `rofi-theme-selector`):

```css
@theme "london-moquette"
```

**London Deep Level**, in ~/.config/rofi/config.rasi, at the end (or pick it in `rofi-theme-selector`):

```css
@theme "london-deep-level"
```

**London Portland**, in ~/.config/rofi/config.rasi, at the end (or pick it in `rofi-theme-selector`):

```css
@theme "london-portland"
```

**Paris Guimard**, in ~/.config/rofi/config.rasi, at the end (or pick it in `rofi-theme-selector`):

```css

```

**Paris Catacombes**, in ~/.config/rofi/config.rasi, at the end (or pick it in `rofi-theme-selector`):


**Paris Carrelage**, in ~/.config/rofi/config.rasi, at the end (or pick it in `rofi-theme-selector`):

```css

```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.local/share/rofi/themes/subway-seat.rasi`.
- Delete `~/.local/share/rofi/themes/subway-seat-tunnel.rasi`.
- Delete `~/.local/share/rofi/themes/subway-seat-enamel.rasi`.
- Delete `~/.local/share/rofi/themes/london-moquette.rasi`.
- Delete `~/.local/share/rofi/themes/london-deep-level.rasi`.
- Delete `~/.local/share/rofi/themes/london-portland.rasi`.
- Delete `~/.local/share/rofi/themes/paris-guimard.rasi`.
- Delete `~/.local/share/rofi/themes/paris-catacombes.rasi`.
- Delete `~/.local/share/rofi/themes/paris-carrelage.rasi`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.
